text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During summer training camp, Sakura 
Chiyono O ran across the sandy beach with 
everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... haah...
choice_data_list:
Increase your turnover rate even more next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Chiyo-chan is really pumped up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky, are you on a break?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Rudolf... Yes, I'm on vacation, 
enjoying the sea breeze.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Because there's a nice view here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown is quite a 
bustling spectacle too. Yaeno Muteki, seen 
as the favorite for the Kikuka Sho, and 
Super Creek, waiting vigilantly for her 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...However, more than anything, it seems 
the public just won't leave those two 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Facing the "White Lightning," whose 
unstoppable charge through sheer effort 
defies all convention, stands the 
"Monster," carrying the dreams of those in 
the regional circuits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap, in particular, is shifting the 
tides of society itself. An extraordinary 
talent who captivates even non-racing 
fans, with everyone eagerly anticipating 
her next triumph.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Autumn Tenno Sho they'll be running in 
is going to be a once-in-a-lifetime 
spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...It's fresh girls like them who make 
today's Twinkle Series shine so brightly."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a racing boom where everything 
is thriving.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is a path paved by the girls who came 
after us. And now, a path of our own has 
opened up for us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky. I hear you have yet to reply 
to your invitation, the offer to enter the 
Dream Trophy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The URA is apparently very eager to have 
you. It's a race that prioritizes star 
power over competitiveness. ...It wouldn't 
be a bad deal for you, either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You won't be able to return to the Twinkle 
Series, but if you're hesitating to race 
as you are now, we could treat this as a 
turning point to the next step—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...I know, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I was planning on giving her 
all the treasures I'd kept secret, too."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All my hopes for the things I couldn't 
grasp, too. Packed with so, so many 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Before the things I can't do start 
piling up, I wanted to pass on everything 
that I can do.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I thought as long as I could pass it on to 
that girl who said she wanted to be like 
me, I'd be fine with it ending right 
there...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And yet... I wonder why. Both that girl... 
and me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *pant*... I can still keep 
going... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, I'm not nearly good 
enough... so, please... more, give me 
more...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Deep in Sakura Chiyono O's eyes, a fire 
burned brighter and hotter than the summer 
sun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's different from how she was before 
the Satsuki Sho— from her muscle tone to 
her overall physical conditioning. Even 
with intense workouts, she should be 
completely fine."
choice_data_list: Let's keep up the beach running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Collision training...? Are you 
serious...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind me saying, I'm actually 
pretty decent at this, you know? 
Trainer-san, you might get blown away...
choice_data_list: There's no way they meant me.
You're not going up against me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...? Then who—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Dosukoi☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Guh... A worthy opponent! If it's Tracen 
Academy's very own super-sized sumo 
Umamusume, Hishi Akebono-san...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
However, in sumo, there are no weight 
classes! Come, once more! This time, I 
will be the attacker!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Bu~no~♪ You've got great look in your 
eyes. I'll give it my all as your sparring 
partner too~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's do this! Ready, set... go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still in the ring!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CRAAAACK!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the shining sun, the two continued 
their sparring, sweat scattering within 
the ring they treated as a dohyo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, it seems to have also helped 
strengthen her lower body and power up for 
races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll push myself to the 
absolute limit—
Uwoooooooh!! May I join in on that run?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Bamboo-san!? You're charging with 
unbelievable momentum!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I really wanted to race against 
Chiyono O at least once!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
W-With me!? But Bamboo-san, I heard your 
next race is on dirt too, so our chances 
of competing are still...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because we can't usually run 
together! Taking advantage of this 
training camp, regardless of our next 
battlefield, I want to meet strong 
Umamusume, run with them, and train!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Please, I'm begging you like this!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooooo much! Counting on 
youuuu!!
choice_data_list: Make sure Chiyono O doesn't lose, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm! I will not lose. Please watch 
closely, see how I run!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, not to be outdone by Bamboo 
Memory, Sakura Chiyono O took off 
sprinting along the sandy beach.
